name: Vipps MobilePay Commerce
description: A Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Vipps MobilePay (uses the Commerce notify webhook + Vipps SDK).
project_description:
We are one Nordic mobile wallet that was once two: Vipps, founded in Norway and MobilePay, which originated in Denmark. Both launched with a mission to deliver a service that made sending money as easy as sending a text.

 This module provides integration with Drupal Commerce, the popular and robust eCommerce platform built with Drupal.

 Features 
 This module provides three payment gateways plugins for Vipps MobilePay API products:

- ePayment

- Recurring

- Checkout

 Post-Installation 
 Once the module is downloaded (with Composer) and enabled you can start using it by providing API credentials obtained from Merchant Portal or your Vipps MobilePay partner and creating a respective payment gateway.

 Additional Requirements 
 This project needs to be downloaded with Composer. It requires Vipps MobilePay module for credentials management and zaporylie/vipps SDK.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Vipps MobilePay also allows you to sign up for a user account or log in to an existing account with Vipps MobilePay Login.

 Supporting this Module 
 This module was developed by Frontkom and sponsored by Vipps MobilePay
